COPY

B.4.c.                                                                 Mrs. Brander (B.13)

Further to our telephone conversation this morning, Major Whetmore rang me up and asked me to write direct to him.

I enclose herewith for Colonel Hinchley Cooke's information a copy of my letter.

18.3.41.                                                                 sgd. R. Pilkington.
